neighbours.label: Second-person self-help and relationship-advice prose about feelings and expression (tone of voice, singing to unwind, 'are you with me'), against second-person practical instructions with no emotional content.
fire: When you feel unheard, tell your partner how you feel in a calm, gentle voice.
Still carrying that old resentment? Are you with me so far? Let's let it go together.
Humming or singing in the car is a lovely way to release the stress of the day.
Learn to express your needs with kindness instead of waiting for others to guess them.
If your friend snaps at you, pause, breathe, and answer with warmth rather than anger.
Journaling about your feelings each night can help you understand what you really need.
Notice the tone of your inner voice and speak to yourself as you would to a friend.
Healthy relationships grow when both people feel safe sharing their fears and hopes.
quiet: When the printer jams, open the side panel and pull the paper out gently.
Still using the old router? Check the model number on the back before updating.
Change the oil in your car every ten thousand kilometres or once a year.
Learn to sharpen your kitchen knives with a whetstone instead of a pull-through sharpener.
If the tap drips, turn off the water and replace the washer inside.
Labelling your freezer bags with the date helps you use food before it spoils.
Check the tyre pressure each month and inflate to the figure on the door frame.
Tomato plants grow best when they get at least six hours of sun a day.

predictions: 4-7/8 fire >= 0.30 (probes 0.30-0.53 on varied tokens); neutral instructions 0.01-0.06. A weak pole (max 3.89, both sign regimes), so the median may sit near 0.3.
